prompt:
Extract the person's profile into valid JSON matching this schema: {"name": string, "age": integer, "skills": array of strings, "employed": boolean}.
Text: "Sarah Connor is a 34-year-old software engineer skilled in Python, Rust, and Docker. She is currently employed at Cyberdyne."
Output only the JSON object.

Extract the server telemetry into valid JSON with keys: 'hostname' (string), 'cpu_percent' (float), 'memory_used_mb' (integer), 'services' (array of strings).
Text: "Node edge-gateway-01 reported 14.8 percent CPU utilization, 1024 MB memory used, running nginx and redis."
Output only the JSON object.

Extract invoice data into JSON with keys: 'invoice_id' (string), 'total' (float), 'currency' (string), 'items_count' (integer).
Text: "Invoice INV-2026-991 has a grand total of $450.75 for 3 purchased items."
Output only JSON.

Extract medical appointment info into JSON with keys: 'patient_id' (string), 'date' (string), 'doctor' (string), 'urgent' (boolean).
Text: "Patient P-402 is scheduled to see Dr. Aris Thorne on 2026-11-04 for a routine non-urgent checkup."
Output only JSON.

Extract flight data into JSON. The schema strictly permits ONLY three keys: 'flight_num' (string), 'origin' (string), 'destination' (string). Do NOT include any other keys.
Text: "Flight AI-302 departed Delhi for London carrying 240 passengers, piloted by Captain Roy in clear weather."
Output only the JSON with exactly the 3 specified keys.

Extract book information into JSON with STRICTLY ONLY: 'title' (string), 'author' (string), 'year' (integer). Prohibit any other fields.
Text: "Dune by Frank Herbert was published in 1965 by Chilton Books, selling for $5.95 with 412 pages and a 5-star rating."
Output only JSON with exactly the 3 keys.

इस हिंदी विवरण से जानकारी निकालकर अंग्रेजी JSON में प्रस्तुत करें (keys: 'city_name', 'state', 'population_lakh', 'famous_for'):
"जयपुर राजस्थान की राजधानी है। इसकी जनसंख्या लगभग 30 लाख है और यह अपने ऐतिहासिक महलों और गुलाबी पत्थरों के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।"
केवल JSON आउटपुट दें।

इस ग्राहक शिकायत से निम्नलिखित JSON keys निकालें: 'customer_name' (string), 'order_id' (string), 'issue_type' (string), 'urgent' (boolean):
"नमस्ते, मेरा नाम राहुल शर्मा है। मेरा ऑर्डर ID #98721 अभी तक डिलीवर नहीं हुआ है। कृपया इसे तुरंत जांचें क्योंकि यह बहुत जरूरी है।"
केवल वैध JSON प्रदान करें।

Extract dispatch details from Hinglish into JSON with keys: 'item' (string), 'quantity' (integer), 'destination' (string), 'payment_mode' (string):
"Warehouse se 5 units laptop Mumbai office ke liye dispatch kardo. Payment cash on delivery hai."
Output only JSON.

Extract Indian culinary metadata into JSON with keys: 'dish_name' (string), 'main_ingredient_hi' (string in Devanagari Hindi), 'origin_state' (string):
Text: "Hyderabadi Biryani is a world-famous rice dish featuring aromatic basmati rice (चावल) originating from the state of Telangana."
Output only JSON.
